pages.name: Royal Queen
pages.text: Royal Summoning ritual. Overworld, by day.

Summoned by the Royal Summoning ritual, not made from a gem. One per world; when she dies every player is told, and she can be summoned again. She can ride in a bee jar.$(br2)$(l)Flowers:$() any flower, Honey Block$(br2)$(l)Home biome:$() none

$(l)Brings home$() (busy hive):$(li)Royal Honeycomb: every trip, 48.9 per hour, her alone$(br2)$(l)Royal queen:$() Hives within 16 blocks of her work 20% faster. Heals bees within 8 blocks (and herself) by half a heart every 5 seconds. Never despawns; one per world.
She has no gem: she is summoned by the $(l:rituals/queen)Royal Summoning$(/l).
